title: In Preview: User Acceptance Testing with the Page Scripting Tool (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Live Demo - Playing Back Scripts and Sharing

features.name: Page Scripting Tool
features.description: A tool allowing customers and consultants to record and play user acceptance tests directly in the Business Central web client, driving higher test coverage and agility while reducing costs. Supports script composition, parameterization, and collaborative testing.
features.status_evidence_quote: we released this tool as a preview in 2024 release way one
caveats: Requires separate permissions for recording and playback
Playback can insert or change data in environment
Must be run in similar environment where recorded
Limited editing support during recording
Suite management only in YAML
Pipeline execution not yet supported

features.name: Validation Steps
features.description: Ability to insert validation steps during recording by right-clicking controls to verify expected outcomes. Users can configure validation values and operators such as equal to, greater than, or less than.
features.status_evidence_quote: we released this tool as a preview in 2024 release way one
caveats: Values shown during recording can be modified afterward

features.name: Script Persistence in YAML Format
features.description: Scripts are saved in YAML format as a metadata-driven format that can be downloaded, shared with others, edited, and rerun in similar environments to verify behavior over time. Supports DevOps integration scenarios.
features.status_evidence_quote: we released this tool as a preview in 2024 release way one
caveats: Scripts must be run in environments with similar pages, objects, and functionality

features.name: Single-Step Playback Controls
features.description: Users can navigate through recorded steps using next and previous buttons for single-step execution, rewind to restart, and see visual indicators for passing and failing steps with error details.
features.status_evidence_quote: we released this tool as a preview in 2024 release way one
caveats: No undo functionality when going backward
Previous action redoes steps rather than undoing

features.name: Run To Step Feature
features.description: Users can right-click on a step in the context menu and select run to execute playback only up to that specific step, allowing partial test execution and step-by-step validation during test execution.

features.name: Playback Link Sharing
features.description: Users can copy a self-contained link from the toolbar that includes the full recording and execution state encoded in a Base64 hash payload for efficient sharing. Other users can review and investigate test results through the link.
caveats: Link includes full recording and state in Base64 encoded format
Requires access to the same environment

features.name: Page Scripting Clipboard
features.description: Dedicated clipboard for storing values captured during recording steps and reusing them in follow-up steps through copy and paste operations via context menu.

features.name: Session Information Pasting
features.description: Ability to access and paste session information such as User ID into test steps using the page scripting context menu.

features.name: Conditional Step Branches
features.description: Feature to create branches in test scripts that execute only when specified conditions are met, such as checking row count values, allowing for conditional test logic and scenario-based execution.

features.name: Optional Pages
features.description: Ability to mark pages as optional in test scripts so that steps recorded on those pages only execute if the page is actually displayed during playback, handling dynamic workflows.

features.name: Nested Structure Collapsing
features.description: UI capability to collapse nested conditional and optional page structures in long scripts for improved readability and easier navigation.

features.name: Power FX Expressions
features.description: Support for Power FX expression language in the properties pane for simple calculations, with access to clipboard, parameters, and session info objects during script recording and playback.

features.name: Wait Steps
features.description: Ability to insert wait steps with configurable delay duration to accommodate scenarios where operations take extra time or external web service calls need to complete during playback.
caveats: Defaults to 1 second or 1000 milliseconds
Should be used sparingly only when needed

features.name: Script Parameters
features.description: YAML-only feature allowing parameterization of scripts with variables that can be reused throughout the script and modified in one place rather than multiple locations, enabling reusable script definitions.
caveats: Only editable in YAML format, not in web client UI
Scripts must use parameters for suite composition to work
Limited editing support in web client

features.name: Script Suites with Include Command
features.description: YAML-only feature to bundle multiple smaller scripts together and execute them in sequence using include commands, allowing parameter sharing across scripts and enabling complex test scenarios.
caveats: Only available in YAML, not in web client UI
Limited editing support in web client
Included scripts must use parameters
Order of scripts matters

features.name: Filter-based List Selection
features.description: When selecting items from lists, users can apply filters during recording to ensure the correct line is at the top and will be reliably selected during replay, improving script robustness.
caveats: Does not track specific instance identifiers like invoice numbers

features.name: Pipeline Execution for Scripts
features.description: Capability to run page scripting tool scripts as part of CI-CD pipelines and development workflows to detect regressions during rollout and automate testing in DevOps scenarios.
features.status_evidence_quote: that we're working on but uh we and um it's not yet supported to run
caveats: Currently only supported execution in client
Under development
First version with known limitations

features.name: Designer and Embedded Content Limitations
features.description: The tool does not record designer interactions, cannot close report previews, and cannot automate control types like charts, embedded Power BI, Power Apps, or content outside Business Central.
caveats: Not an HTML automation tool
Limited to Business Central controls

features.name: Control Identification and Notifications
features.description: The tool relies on named control references in the UI to function correctly. Issues can occur with notifications, confirmation dialogues, and race conditions when the same field names appear in different locations or in different execution sequences.
caveats: Race condition risks with messages and dialogues
Requires next/previous buttons on cards
